overall: The AG found the Commission violated the OML by entering executive session on October 22, 2013 to discuss the airport audit, a topic with no lawful executive purpose, and ordered compliance and release of the relevant minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission entered executive session for an improper purpose at its October 22, 2013 meeting, including discussion of the airport audit.
allegations.key_passage: Because there is no purpose that generally allows a public body to enter into executive session to discuss an audit, the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by holding this discussion outside of public view.

allegations.summary: The executive session also listed proposed tenant litigation and an avigation easement topic, which the complaint did not allege were improper purposes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Publicly release, at its next regularly scheduled meeting, the portion of the October 22, 2013 executive session minutes covering the discussion of the Airport Audit.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Commission that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law. Additionally, we order the Commission to publicly release at its next regularly scheduled meeting the portion of the October 22, 2013 executive session minutes that covers the discussion of the Airport Audit.
